definition: The group of words that label the parts of a glossary entry on its own page: its other names, the words not to confuse it with, what it rests on, and the rest.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`glossary-field` holds the parts of a glossary record, which label the term page", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
